python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, re
root = pathlib.Path("docs/evidence/heb-154/agent-code-v2")
pack_path = root / "scenarios/proposed/scenario-pack.json"
doc_path = root / "execution-contract.md"
pack = json.loads(pack_path.read_text())
doc = doc_path.read_text()
quote = chr(96)
expected = {}
for case in pack["cases"]:
    expected.setdefault(case["family_id"], set()).update(event["kind"] for event in case["event_schedule"])
def bindings(text):
    rows = re.findall(r"^\| (FRD-\d{2}) \| ([^|]+) \|", text, re.M)
    if len(rows) != len({row[0] for row in rows}):
        raise ValueError("duplicate_family_binding")
    actual = {family: set(re.findall(quote + r"([^" + quote + r"]+)" + quote, cell)) for family, cell in rows}
    if actual != expected:
        raise ValueError("event_family_binding_mismatch")
    return actual
def references(text):
    oracle_refs = set(re.findall(r"\bO-[A-Z]+(?:-[A-Z]+)*\b", text))
    control_refs = set(re.findall(r"\bCTRL-[A-Z]+(?:-[A-Z]+)*\b", text))
    if not oracle_refs <= {row["oracle_id"] for row in pack["oracles"]}:
        raise ValueError("unknown_oracle_reference")
    if not control_refs <= {row["control_id"] for row in pack["controls"]}:
        raise ValueError("unknown_control_reference")
    return sorted(oracle_refs), sorted(control_refs)
actual = bindings(doc)
oracle_refs, control_refs = references(doc)
obligations = re.findall(r"^\| (FRDX-[a-z-]+) \| ([^|]+) \| ([^|]+) \| ([^|]+) \|$", doc, re.M)
assert obligations and len(obligations) == len({row[0] for row in obligations})
assert all(all(cell.strip() for cell in row[1:]) for row in obligations)
caught = []
def dirty(name, function, text, expected_reason):
    try:
        function(text)
    except ValueError as exc:
        assert str(exc) == expected_reason, str(exc)
        caught.append(name)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("undetected_dirty_control:" + name)
dirty("missing_event_kind", bindings, doc.replace(quote + "advance_clock" + quote, quote + "omitted_event_control" + quote, 1), "event_family_binding_mismatch")
dirty("missing_family_row", bindings, re.sub(r"^\| FRD-01 \|[^\n]+\n", "", doc, count=1, flags=re.M), "event_family_binding_mismatch")
dirty("unknown_oracle_reference", references, doc + "\nO-UNDECLARED\n", "unknown_oracle_reference")
dirty("unknown_control_reference", references, doc + "\nCTRL-UNDECLARED\n", "unknown_control_reference")
print(json.dumps({
    "scope": "Static authoring check of the complete public registry's family/event-kind membership against the execution draft, named oracle/control references and populated obligation columns. Does not validate prose semantics, execute events, exercise service fences/transactions/access controls, evaluate agents, or inspect hidden/native fixture populations.",
    "result": "static_inventory_checks_passed",
    "case_ids": [c["case_id"] for c in pack["cases"]],
    "event_kinds_by_family": {k: sorted(v) for k, v in sorted(actual.items())},
    "obligation_ids": [row[0] for row in obligations],
    "oracle_references": oracle_refs,
    "control_references": control_refs,
    "authoring_dirty_controls_detected": caught,
    "pack_sha256": hashlib.sha256(pack_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "execution_contract_sha256": hashlib.sha256(doc_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
}, indent=2))
